title: Control Plane Profile — workflow manifest (SPEC.md §26.3)
description: The machine-readable graph of trigger, connectors, compute nodes, gates, and actions. Every control-plane run records workflow_manifest_digest = SHA-256 of THIS document's JCS-canonical form — the digest is carried by referencing objects, never stored inside the manifest itself. env_overlays are by reference only; a literal secret value here is a producer bug, not a schema violation this shape check can catch on its own (contract-level rule, §26.3).

haGatePolicy.description: OCG SPEC.md §27.4 (v0.8.12) closed vocabulary, additive here per §1 item 5 of HELM-HA-BUILD-SPEC.md — mirrors hub/vendored/ocg's $defs/haGatePolicy so a pack step can declare a §27.4 human-accountability precondition helmd's run engine (hub/run.mjs gateCheck) actually enforces.

gate_policy.description: OPTIONAL — when present, the run engine HOLDS immediately before this node executes until §27.4 is satisfied against the preceding node's artifact.

gate_role.description: OPTIONAL — the OCG SPEC.md §27.1 haRole a satisfying record must carry. Defaults to "approver" when omitted.

gate_threshold.description: OPTIONAL — N distinct identities required for dual_control/review_required/hold (§27.3). Defaults per hub/vendored/ocg's evaluateHaGate (2 for dual_control, 1 otherwise) when omitted.

vault_ref.description: Opaque secret reference into the vault (D-class secret store). NEVER a secret value.

connector_id.description: MUST match a connector_id present in this manifest's connectors[].

required_inputs.description: What the user must supply, derived from node param schemas — vs kernel-internal wiring (HELM-PHASE2-BUILD-SPEC.md §2).

source_chain_ref.description: Provenance back to the site chaingraph.json chain this pack was compiled from (HELM-PHASE2-BUILD-SPEC.md §2 compiler).

connector_inputs.description: DEC-6a: optional connector-fetch input steps — trigger -> connector fetch -> kernel -> evidence composition.
